akwaibom_justice_crime_2007_2012.name: Justice and Crime Statistics, Akwa Ibom State (2007-2012), Tables 1(a)-1(f)
akwaibom_justice_crime_2007_2012.publisher: Directorate of Statistics, Ministry of Economic Development, Akwa Ibom State (hosted in the NBS e-library); data from Nigeria Police Force, Akwa Ibom State Command
akwaibom_justice_crime_2007_2012.notes: Extracted from PDF with pdftotext -layout. Each LGA row has M and F columns for Murder Case, Manslaughter and Attempted Murder; the publication does not say whether M/F refers to victims or suspects, so breakdown is labelled 'Male (M column)'/'Female (F column)'. LGA columns were checked against each table's Total row: all match except 2008 Attempted murder F (Total row says 1, LGA rows sum to 0). State rows are from Table 1(f) summary (Murder 99/52/94/101/110 for 2007-2011).

problems: NBS 2016 report/table gives only offence-group totals by state (no murder line), so it is kept in raw/ but yields no rows. Akwa Ibom LGAs matched by exact name to geoBoundaries ADM2 features lying inside the Akwa Ibom ADM1 polygon (all 31 matched).
